title: Archive Receipt Index
description: Queryable index of all archived task executions. Stored at .wabblespec/state/archive/receipt-index.json. Append-only task entries; status fields updated in place as execution progresses.

index_version.description: Schema version. Increment on structural changes.

last_updated.description: Timestamp of the most recent write to this index.

tasks.description: One entry per archived task execution. Ordered oldest-first.

task_id.description: Unique execution identifier. Format: <target-slug>-<ISO-date>-<3-digit-seq>. Example: cli-2026-05-22-001.

target.description: Platform target from recipe.json. e.g. CLI, Web, API-Service.

status.description: PENDING: task created, execution not started. IN_PROGRESS: at least one wave receipt written. PASS: delivery receipt written, all_waves_passed true. FAIL: delivery receipt written, at least one wave FAIL or missing receipt. BLOCKED: execution halted awaiting human input (escalation gate).

started_at.description: Timestamp when ScopeFrame receipt was first written for this task.

archived_at.description: Timestamp when Archive wrote the delivery receipt. Null until Archive runs.

delivery_receipt_path.description: Relative path to delivery-receipt-<timestamp>.json. Null until Archive runs.

version_previous.description: Semver before bump. Null until Archive runs.

version_new.description: Semver after bump. Null until Archive runs.

waves_completed.description: Waves that completed with Verifier PASS. Updated after each wave.

not_tested_items.description: Total not_tested item count from all receipts. Updated at Archive time.

not_tested_list.description: Aggregated not_tested items verbatim. Queryable to scope future sessions. Updated at Archive time.

missing_receipts.description: Required receipts absent at Archive time. Non-empty only when status=FAIL.

blocked_reason.description: Human-readable reason for BLOCKED status. Null when not BLOCKED.

receipts_by_module.description: Per-module receipt status. Keys are module IDs. Enables query by module.

status.description: SKIP: module not applicable for this task (e.g. Reviewer not triggered).

receipt_path.description: Relative path to this module's receipt file. Null if not yet written.
